ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; approximately 70% low-intensity (dark) pixels dominating the central region and 30% high-intensity (white) pixels localized at the lateral tips and peripheral mottling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central dark pigmentation spanning the notch and majority of both lobes. High-intensity white contiguous zones on the far left and right tips. Extensive white-on-black mottling (speckling) concentrated near the peduncle insertion and lower inner lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with an estimated pixel angle of 55 degrees; narrow depth relative to lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and serrated trailing edge with frequent high-amplitude peaks and valleys, particularly pronounced on the inner trailing edge of both lobes and the distal portions.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curve on the leading edges tapering to narrow, acute tips; overall fluke shape displays a sharp upward sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-contrast white circular pixel clusters (speckling) distributed across the dark central and lower-right regions of the ventral surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Significant dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) on the white lateral tips; notable cluster of 4-5 parallel diagonal lines on the left tip and shorter vertical marks on the right tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks on lateral tips; irregular, jagged trailing edge topography suggests significant previous tissue loss or mechanical wear.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique asymmetric black-to-white transition pattern on the distal edges of both fluke lobes.
